name: Revisit testing and reporting infrastructure
goal: Re-examine the test chain (test:all, 111 npm-run steps), the governance profiler, and the reporting/logging surfaces. Decide which suites stay, which merge, which are retired, and how results are reported, so failures name a check and environment-dependent behavior is explicit. Replace the ad hoc decisions made while taming the codebase with a reviewed plan.

metadata.refinementNote: Reviewed plan produced: docs/plans/testing-and-reporting-infrastructure-review.md covers canonical test chain (114 steps), governance profiler decomposition (collection/scheduling/execution/reporting), test/report/logging surfaces, decision matrix for distinct/merge/retire (target ~70 checks), and failure identification with environment explicit. No broad refactor in this expedition; plan ready for follow-up expeditions EXP-TEST-001 to 004.
